diagnosis: getFdFromIpcHandle and getIpcHandleFromFd both require membership in the calling driver local IPC export map. A received SCM_RIGHTS descriptor is valid in the OS but is not a local export-map entry; INVALID_ARGUMENT before import is expected.
correction: Keep native exporter FD/layout validation on both ranks.
Validate SCM_RIGHTS descriptor with fstat and retain its lifetime through peer mapping close.
If received fd equals exporter numeric fd, duplicate using F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC minimum exporter+1, then close only original received descriptor; preserve every non-FD byte.
Call zeMemOpenIpcHandle directly; changed-FD source branch explicitly imports the supplied descriptor and preserves allocation offset/type metadata.
Do not use the reverse FD conversion API; it has the same local-export-map precondition.
Keep peer access/UUID, SYCL pointer admission, exact output and lifetime gates unchanged.
